desc.en: On Monday, 12th Rabi-ul-Awwal, the Holy Prophet (s) entered a village called Quba which is 5 Kms. on the Hijrat route of Madina. He stayed there till Friday so that Hazrat Ali (a) returns the belongings entrusted to the Holy Prophet (s) to their respective owners and join him after fulfilling other duties along with his family members. On the other hand, the people of Medina got ready to welcome the Holy Prophet (s). The Holy Prophet (s) marked the boundaries of the Mosque with his spear on the ground. It is said that each of its sector was of 66 yards. The Prophet (s) also worked in the construction of this Mosque. He used to carry stones to the construction site and do equal work like others. Some people used to request him to have a seat somewhere and order them but He used to say…
desc.rurdu: Somwaar (Monday), 12th Rabiul Awwal ke din, Rasool-e-Khuda (s) ne Quba naami gaon, jo 5 Kms. Madina ke hijrat waale raaste par hai. Juma (Friday) tak aap (s) ne Hijrat ke waqt Hazrat Ali (a) ka wahan intezaar kiya, jo logo’n ki amaanat lauta kar Rasool-e-Khuda (s) se us maqaam par ja miley. Dusri taraf Madina ke log Rasool-e-Khuda (s) ke isteqbaal ke liye taiyyaar thay. Is jagah par Rasool-e-Khuda (s) ne zameen mein masjid ka naqsha khencha jis ki har simnt 66 farsak ki thi. Rasool-e-Khuda (s) khud is masjid ki taamir mein hissa liye. Woh patthar utha kar le aate aur logo’n ki tarah. kuchh log unko aaraam karne ko kehte magar woh jawaab mein is tarah farmaate…

arabic.text: قَدْ اَفْلَحَ مَن یَّعْمُرُ الْمَسَاجِدَ۔ یَقْرَئُ الْقُرْاٰنَ قَائِمًا وَقَاعِدًا۔

lines.rarabic: QAD AFLAHA MAIY-YA’MO-RUL MASAA-JEDA. YAQRA-UL-QUR-AANA QAA'e MAN WA QAA-E’DAN.

trans.en: One who builds a mosque and recites Holy Qur’an in it with correct rules of recitation is successful.
trans.rurdu: Jis ne masjid banaayi aur us mein Qur’an'e Kareem ki sahih tariqe se tilaawat ki to woh kaamyaab hai.
trans.urdu: انشاء اللہ ترجمہ جلد آرہا ہے

desc.en: The verse of Surah Tawbah (9:108) is revealed specifically for this mosque…
desc.rurdu: Surah Tawbah ki aayat (9:108) khaas is masjid ke liye naazil huwi hai…

arabic.text: ۔۔۔لَمَسْجِدٌ اُسِّسَ عَلَى التَّقْوٰى مِنْ اَوَّلِ يَوْمٍ اَحَقُّ اَنْ تَقُوْمَ فِيْهِ

lines.rarabic: …LA-MASJE-DOON USSE-SA A’LAT TAQWAA MIN AWWALE YAWMIN A-HAQQO AN TAQOOMA FEEHE, FEEHE REJAA-LOON YOHIB-BOONA AYYAT-TAH-HAROO, WALLAAHO YOHIBBUL MUTAHHE-REENA.

trans.en: …Certainly a masjid founded on piety from the very first day is more deserving that you should stand in it; in it are men who love that they should be purified; and Allah loves those who purify themselves.
trans.rurdu: …Jis masjid ki bunyaad roze awwal se taqwa par hai woh is qaabil hai keh aap us mein namaaz adaa kare. Us mein woh mard bhi hai jo tahaarat ko dost rakhte hai aur Khuda bhi paakeeza afraad se mohabbat karta hai.

desc.en: The Messenger of Allah (s) used to visit the Mosque of Quba every Monday and pray there. A tradition from him says that "One who performs wuzu at his house and goes to the Mosque of Quba and prays 2 rakats namaz will get the reward of an Umrah."
desc.rurdu: Allah ke Nabi (s), musalsal har Monday ko is masjid mein aa kar ibaadat anjaam dete. Unse hadees mein hai keh, “Jo koi apne ghar se wuzu karke Masjid Quba jaaye aur wahan par 2 rakat namaz adaa kare, to usey Umrah ka sawaab haasil hoga.”

desc.en: Also, Imam Sadiq (a) said, "When you visit the mosques around Medina, go to the Mosque of Quba first and pray there as far as possible."
desc.rurdu: Imam Sadiq (a) ne bhi farmaya, “Jab bhi tum Madine ki masjido’n ki ziyarat par jaawo, to pehle Masjid Quba jaawo aur wahan ziyadah se ziyadah ibaadat anjaam do.”

desc.en: Upon entering the Mosque one should perform 2 rakats namaz of respect. Then recite Tasbeeh-e-Zahra (s) after than recite the <Ziyarat Jame’a Kabir> and then recite <Allahumma innaka qulta wa qawloka>.
desc.rurdu: Masjid mein daakhil hone par 2 rakat namaz, ehteraame masjid ki niyyat se adaa kare. Phir Tasbeeh-e-Zahra (s) ke baad <Ziyarat Jame’a Kabir> aur phir <Allahumma innaka qulta wa qawloka> padhe.
desc.urdu: روزِ اول ہی سے اس مسجد کی بنیاد تقویٰ و پرہیز گاری پر رکھی گئی تھی روایت میں ہے کہ اس مسجد میں ۲ رکعت نماز پڑھنے پر عمرہ کا ثواب ہے۔ اس مسجد میں جاکر ۲ رکعت نماز تحیت مسجد پڑھے اور تسبیح فاطمہ ؑ کے بعد <زیارتِ جامعہ کبیرہ> پڑھے اور پھردعا <اَللّٰہُمَّ اِنَّكَ قُلْتَ وَقَوْلُكَ> پڑھے۔

desc.en: There was a place of Hazrat Ali (a) behind this mosque and a salty water well in the front. There is no sign of this well today. It is said that the finger-ring of the Prophet (s) had fallen in it. Hence it is called ’Chahe Angushtari’ (well of finger-ring) while it is also called ’Chahe Aabe Dahaan’ (Well of saliva). It is said that the Holy Prophet (s) had put his saliva in this well because of which its water became sweet.
desc.rurdu: Is masjid ke peeche Hazrat Ali (a) ki ek jagah hai jahan par namkeen paani ka ek kuwa hai. Aaj us kuwe ka koi nishaan baaqi nahi hai. Kaha jaata hai keh Rasool-e-Khuda (s) ki angooti (finger ring) is kuwe mein gir gayi thi. Is liye isey “Chahe Angushtari”(Well of Ring) aur “Chahe Aabe Dahaan” (Well of saliva) bhi kaha jaata hai.

desc.en: A group of hyprocrites constructed a mosque in 9th Hijri so that they could oppose Islam and Muslims. The Prophet (s) was asked to pray in it for its inauguration and as an offering. The Holy Prophet (s) said that he would do so on a suitable occasion. But the revelation of the verse (9:107)... wal ladinat Takhad’u Masjidan Z’iraran wa kufran...’ destroyed their plans and the Prophet (s) ordered to demolish it.
desc.rurdu: Munafiq ka ek giroh ne 9 Hijri mein ek masjid ki taamir ki, ta-keh woh Islam aur Musalmaan ke khilaaf saajish kar sakey. Rasool-e-Khuda (s) ko un munaafiqo’n ne us masjid mein namaz ki daawat di, magar Aap (s) ne yeh kahe kar taal diya keh mai koi khaas mauqe par aa kar is amal ko anjaam dunga. Is par aayat (9:107) naazil huwi jis par Rasool (s) ne us masjid ko daah (tod) ne ka hukm diya.

lines.rarabic: WAL-LAZEE-NAT TAKHA-ZOO MASJE-DAN ZERAA-RAN WA KUFRAN…

trans.en: And those who built a masjid to cause harm and for unbelief…
trans.rurdu: Aur jin logo’n ne masjid Zaraara banaayi keh uske zariye Islam ko nuqsaan pohonchaaye aur kufr ko taqwiyat (taaqat) bakhshe…
